summary: Master M&E and Impact Assessment techniques for Food and Nutrition Security Projects. Enroll in our course to drive effective change and improve lives.
lede: Monitoring and impact assessment for food and nutrition security projects tracks outcomes and evaluates interventions. It is for professionals working on food security, agriculture and nutrition programmes, and covers theories of change, dietary and anthropometric indicators, and baseline assessments. Participants also learn to design mobile data collection, choose impact evaluation approaches, analyze results and report findings.
audienceIntro: This training is specifically structured for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, and reporting on food security, agriculture, and nutrition interventions.
modules: Digital Data Collection for Field Monitoring
Impact Evaluation Designs for FNS Projects
Qualitative M&E and Accountability to Affected Populations
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management, community development, or humanitarian response operations. No advanced statistical or coding experience is required. You will need to bring a laptop to participate in the digital data collection and indicator calculation exercises.
